Bradley Foster & Sargent Lifted Holding in Bank Of America (BAC); As Agnico Eagle Mines LTD (AEM) Market Valuation Rose, Essex Investment Management Co Raised Position by $564,354
June 20, 2018 - By Stephen Andrade
Bradley Foster & Sargent Inc increased its stake in Bank Of America (BAC) by 19.82% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bradley Foster & Sargent Inc bought 41,504 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.97% with the market. The institutional investor held 250,931 shares of the major banks company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $7.53M, up from 209,427 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bradley Foster & Sargent Inc who had been investing in Bank Of America for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $296.48 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.07% or $0.02 during the last trading session, reaching $29.24. About 51.98M shares traded. Bank of America Corporation (NYSE:BAC) has risen 29.72% since June 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 17.15% the S&P500.
